source_quote:
![critical]
> The `volumes` block for `shared-volume` was accidentally pasted inside the worker container's `resources` limits block, completely replacing the container's `requests` and `volumeMounts` sections and breaking the YAML structure. This will cause Kubernetes deployment to fail.
> Please restore the container's `resources` and `volumeMounts` blocks here, and instead apply the `shared_volume_path` conditional logic to the `volumes` section at the bottom of the file (lines 198-208).

rule.description: 在编辑 Kubernetes 资源 YAML 模板（如 Jinja2）时，容器 `resources` 块的 `limits`/`requests` 与 `volumeMounts` 必须保持结构完整，不能因粘贴 `volumes` 块而替换掉 `requests`/`volumeMounts` 节，否则会破坏 YAML 结构导致部署失败。
checkpoints: 检查容器 `resources` 块下 `limits` 与 `requests` 是否成对出现且层级正确
检查 `volumeMounts` 是否被误删或被其他块覆盖
检查 `volumes` 块是否被粘贴到了 `resources`/`volumeMounts` 的位置（典型粘贴错误）
检查 Pod 级 `volumes` 是否位于容器 spec 之外（不应嵌套在容器 `resources` 内）

antipattern.code:
# tests/e2e/nightly/multi_node/scripts/lws.yaml.jinja2
# worker 容器的 resources 段，约第 178-210 行
            command:
              - sh
              - -c
              - |
                bash /root/.cache/tests/run.sh \
                  "{{ soc_version | default("") }}" \
                  "{{ max_good_age_days | default("3") }}"
            resources:
              limits:
                memory: 512Gi
                {{ npu_resource_name | default("huawei.com/ascend-1980") }}: {{ npu_per_node | default("16") }}
            # ❌ volumes 块误粘贴到此处，破坏了 resources 块结构
            # requests 和 volumeMounts 节被替换丢失
            - name: shared-volume
              hostPath:
                path: "{{ shared_volume_path }}"
                type: DirectoryOrCreate
            # ❌ 缺少 requests 块（ephemeral-storage, cpu, NPU 资源）
            # ❌ 缺少 volumeMounts 块（/root/.cache, /usr/local/Ascend/driver/tools, /dev/shm）

pattern.code:
# tests/e2e/nightly/multi_node/scripts/lws.yaml.jinja2
            command:
              - sh
              - -c
              - |
                bash /root/.cache/tests/run.sh \
                  "{{ soc_version | default("") }}" \
                  "{{ max_good_age_days | default("3") }}"
            resources:
              limits:
                memory: 512Gi
                ephemeral-storage: 100Gi
                huawei.com/ascend-1980: {{ npu_per_node | default("16") }}
              requests:
                ephemeral-storage: 100Gi
                cpu: 125
                huawei.com/ascend-1980: {{ npu_per_node | default("16") }}
            volumeMounts:
              - mountPath: /root/.cache
                name: shared-volume
              - mountPath: /usr/local/Ascend/driver/tools
                name: driver-tools
              - mountPath: /dev/shm
                name: dshm
        volumes:
        - name: dshm
          emptyDir:
            medium: Memory
            sizeLimit: 512Gi
{% if shared_volume_path %}
        - name: shared-volume
          hostPath:
            path: "{{ shared_volume_path }}"
            type: DirectoryOrCreate
{% else %}
        - name: shared-volume
          persistentVolumeClaim:
            claimName: {{ pvc_name | default("nv-action-vllm-benchmarks-v2") }}
{% endif %}
